name: simsci-internal
description: SimSci-internal agent workflows for vivarium development; depends on the simsci plugin for the generic tooling.

jira_api_token.title: Jira personal access token
jira_api_token.description: Used by the jira MCP server. Create one in Jira under Profile > Personal Access Tokens.

jira_project.title: Default Jira project
jira_project.description: Project key that the jira MCP server creates issues in when none is given.

jira_board_id.title: Jira board ID
jira_board_id.description: Scrum board that sprint names and 'active' resolve against. 301 is the MIC board.
